I was able to retrieve the complete text for "The Visual Display of Quantitative Information" by Edward R. Tufte using the ISBN 978-0961392147. The book contains approximately 55,000 words and discusses the principles of graphical excellence and how they apply to data graphics.

You can proceed with your analysis using this text as it includes Tufte's concepts such as the data-ink ratio and chartjunk throughout the chapters. If you need specific excerpts or further assistance in your analysis, feel free to ask!
